paragraphs: The HSE runs Ireland's public health service. Its board said on Monday that it had sacked the boss of the HSE, Anne O'Connor. Now the board will answer questions from politicians next week.
Ms O'Connor started the job in March. She had a contract for five years. She says she did not know her job was in danger until a call on Saturday. She wants to fight the decision.
A group of TDs looks at health issues. This group wants to know why she lost her job. It also wants to know if the Health Minister played a part.
The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, wants the board to explain more. He did not say that he trusts the board. The Tánaiste, Simon Harris, said she is a good person.
A court case could cost a lot of money. The taxpayer would pay.

paragraphs: The board of the HSE, which runs Ireland's public health service, is expected to answer questions from politicians next week. The board decided to sack the HSE's chief executive, Anne O'Connor, and many people were shocked by the news.
Ms O'Connor only started in the job in March. She had a five-year contract, but the board announced on Monday that it was ending it. All members of the board agreed with the decision.

Ms O'Connor says she did not know her job was in danger until a video call early on Saturday morning. She has said she will challenge what she calls an unlawful decision. Her lawyer told the High Court that the HSE has now invited her to try mediation, where both sides talk with the help of a neutral person.

The Oireachtas health committee, a group of TDs and senators, has invited the board to a meeting. Its chair, Pádraig Rice, said the committee needs to find out why she was sacked and whether the Health Minister, Jennifer Carroll MacNeill, had any role.

The Tánaiste, Simon Harris, told the Dáil that the board chair would lead a group to the committee. He said Ms O'Connor was a good and decent person, but he would wait for all the facts before making a judgment.

The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, said her statement raised serious issues, and he wants the board to give a fuller explanation. However, he did not say that he had confidence in the board. Sinn Féin claimed the minister was behind the sacking.
Any court case or mediation could be expensive, and the cost would be paid by the State.
sentZh: 負責經營愛爾蘭公共醫療服務的HSE，其董事會預計下週將回答政治人物的提問。
董事會決定開除HSE執行長安妮・歐康納，許多人對這個消息感到震驚。
歐康納女士三月才開始做這份工作。
她有一份五年合約，但董事會在星期一宣布要終止合約。
董事會所有成員都同意這個決定。
歐康納女士說，直到星期六清晨的一通視訊電話，她才知道自己可能失去工作。
她表示將對她所稱的違法決定提出挑戰。
她的律師告訴高等法院，HSE現在已邀請她嘗試調解，也就是雙方在一位中立人士協助下進行對話。
由國會議員和參議員組成的國會衛生委員會，已邀請董事會出席會議。
委員會主席帕德里格・萊斯說，委員會需要查明她為何被開除，以及衛生部長珍妮佛・卡洛・麥克尼爾是否扮演了任何角色。
副總理賽門・哈里斯在眾議院表示，董事會主席將率領一個小組前往委員會。
他說歐康納女士是個善良正派的人，但他會等所有事實釐清後再做判斷。
總理米霍爾・馬丁說，她的聲明提出了嚴重的問題，他希望董事會給出更完整的解釋。
不過，他沒有表示對董事會有信心。
新芬黨聲稱，部長才是這次開除事件的幕後推手。
任何官司或調解都可能所費不貲，而費用將由國家支付。

paragraphs: The board of the Health Service Executive (HSE) is expected to appear before an Oireachtas committee next week to explain its controversial decision to dismiss the organisation's chief executive, Anne O'Connor.

Ms O'Connor, who took up the post in March, had been appointed on a five-year contract. The board's unanimous decision to terminate it, announced on Monday, caused widespread shock across the political system and the health service.

In two public statements, Ms O'Connor has said she was unaware that her position was under threat until a Teams call at 7.30am on Saturday. She has vowed to challenge what she describes as her unlawful termination, and her senior counsel told the High Court that the HSE had invited her to enter mediation.

The chair of the Oireachtas health committee, Social Democrats TD Pádraig Rice, said members needed to establish why she had been removed and what role, if any, the Health Minister, Jennifer Carroll MacNeill, had played.

In the Dáil, Tánaiste Simon Harris confirmed that a delegation led by the board's chair would accept the committee's invitation. He praised Ms O'Connor as a good and decent public servant but said he was withholding judgment until the facts were clear.

Taoiseach Micheál Martin has taken a cooler line on the board. He said Ms O'Connor's statement raised serious issues and called for a fuller account, but stopped short of expressing confidence in its members. Sinn Féin's health spokesperson, David Cullinane, accused the minister of orchestrating the dismissal and hiding behind the board.
Whatever the outcome, any mediation or legal action is likely to prove costly for the HSE, with the bill ultimately falling on the taxpayer.
sentZh: 衛生服務執行署（HSE）董事會預計下週將出席國會委員會，說明其解僱該機構執行長安妮・歐康納這項具爭議性的決定。
歐康納女士於三月就任，當時獲得五年任期的合約。
董事會在星期一宣布一致決定終止合約，在政界和醫療體系中引發廣泛震驚。
歐康納女士在兩份公開聲明中表示，直到星期六上午七點半的一通Teams通話，她才知道自己的職位受到威脅。
她誓言要對她所稱的違法解僱提出挑戰，而她的資深大律師告訴高等法院，HSE已邀請她進行調解。
國會衛生委員會主席、社會民主黨議員帕德里格・萊斯表示，委員們需要查明她為何被撤職，以及衛生部長珍妮佛・卡洛・麥克尼爾在其中扮演了什麼角色（如果有的話）。
副總理賽門・哈里斯在眾議院證實，由董事會主席率領的代表團將接受委員會的邀請。
他稱讚歐康納女士是一位善良正派的公僕，但表示在事實釐清之前他將保留判斷。
總理米霍爾・馬丁對董事會的態度則較為冷淡。
他說歐康納女士的聲明提出了嚴重問題，並要求更完整的說明，但沒有進一步表示對董事會成員有信心。
新芬黨衛生事務發言人大衛・庫利南指控部長策劃了這次解僱，並躲在董事會背後。
無論結果如何，任何調解或法律行動都可能讓HSE付出高昂代價，而帳單最終將落在納稅人身上。

paragraphs: The board of the Health Service Executive is poised to appear before an Oireachtas committee next week, where it will face intense scrutiny over its abrupt dismissal of the organisation's chief executive, Anne O'Connor.

Ms O'Connor had held the post only since March, having been appointed on a five-year contract. The board's unanimous decision to terminate that contract, made public on Monday, sent shockwaves through both the political establishment and the health service itself.

In two strongly worded statements, Ms O'Connor has insisted that she had no inkling her position was in jeopardy until a Teams call at 7.30am on Saturday. She has pledged to contest what she regards as an unlawful termination, and her senior counsel informed the High Court that the HSE had since proposed mediation.

The committee's chair, Social Democrats TD Pádraig Rice, said members were determined to ascertain why she had been ousted and what part, if any, the Health Minister, Jennifer Carroll MacNeill, had played in the affair.

Tánaiste Simon Harris told the Dáil that a delegation headed by the board's chair would take up the invitation. While lauding Ms O'Connor as a good and decent public servant, he said he was reserving judgment until the full facts emerged.

The Taoiseach, Micheál Martin, struck a noticeably more guarded tone. Acknowledging that Ms O'Connor's account raised grave issues, he demanded a fuller explanation from the board, yet pointedly refrained from voicing confidence in it. Sinn Féin went further, alleging that the minister had orchestrated the sacking while sheltering behind the board.
Regardless of how the dispute is resolved, mediation or litigation threatens to be a costly undertaking, with the bill ultimately landing on the Exchequer.

歐康納女士自三月起才擔任此職，當時獲任命簽下五年合約。
董事會在星期一公布一致決定終止該合約，在政治建制圈和醫療體系內部都引發了震撼。
歐康納女士在兩份措辭強硬的聲明中堅稱，直到星期六上午七點半的一通Teams通話之前，她完全不知道自己的職位岌岌可危。
她承諾要對她所認定的違法解僱提出抗辯，而她的資深大律師告知高等法院，HSE此後已提議進行調解。
委員會主席、社會民主黨議員帕德里格・萊斯說，委員們決心查明她為何被撤換，以及衛生部長珍妮佛・卡洛・麥克尼爾在這起事件中扮演了什麼角色（如果有的話）。
副總理賽門・哈里斯告訴眾議院，由董事會主席率領的代表團將接受邀請。
他雖讚揚歐康納女士是善良正派的公僕，但表示在全部事實浮現前將保留判斷。
總理米霍爾・馬丁的語氣則明顯更為謹慎。
他承認歐康納女士的說法引發了嚴重問題，要求董事會提出更完整的解釋，卻刻意避免表態對董事會有信心。
新芬黨則更進一步，指稱部長策劃了這次解僱，同時躲在董事會背後。
無論這場爭議如何解決，調解或訴訟都可能是一項代價高昂的事，而帳單最終將落到國庫頭上。
